mcat_description.short: Portable Security Cabins are compact, factory-built prefabricated structures designed to house security guards or watchmen at entry/exit points; sold per unit in standard sizes (4×4 ft to 8×8 ft) and constructed from steel, FRP, PUF panels, or PVC.
mcat_description.long: Portable Security Cabins are relocatable, prefabricated guard rooms manufactured using structural steel frames combined with wall and roof panels of mild steel (MS), galvanised iron (GI), fibre-reinforced plastic (FRP), polyurethane foam (PUF) sandwich panels, or PVC. Standard commercial sizes range from 4×4 ft to 8×8 ft with a height of 7–8.5 ft, and cabins are supplied with aluminium sliding windows, MS or FRP doors, electrical fittings, and optional insulation for thermal comfort. They are deployed at construction site gates, industrial facility entrances, residential gated communities, parking lots, toll plazas, educational institutions, and government checkpoints. Buyers include construction contractors, facility management companies, industrial plant operators, housing societies, and government/PSU procurement departments who require quick-deploy, low-maintenance guard posts without permanent civil construction.

market_context: In the Indian market, 'Portable Security Cabins' is the dominant trade term for compact, relocatable prefabricated guard booths; synonyms in active buyer use include 'watchman cabin', 'porta security cabin', 'guard cabin', and 'prefab security cabin'. The category spans four primary material types — MS/GI steel, FRP (fibre-reinforced plastic), PUF (polyurethane foam) sandwich panels, and PVC — each serving slightly different buyer preferences: PUF panels are preferred for insulation and all-weather comfort, FRP for corrosion resistance in coastal/humid environments, and MS/GI steel for heavy-duty durability. Standard commercial sizes are 4×4 ft, 4×6 ft, 6×6 ft, 6×8 ft, and 8×8 ft with heights of 7–8.5 ft; cabins are supplied with aluminium sliding windows, MS or FRP doors, electrical conduits, and optional insulation. Key manufacturers active in India include EPACK Prefab, Pressmach Infrastructure, UNO Structures, Aakar Fiber Works (Pune), Digvijay Fiber Art (Shegaon/Maharashtra), and Techno PUF Solutions (Hyderabad), with manufacturing hubs in Gujarat (Ahmedabad), Maharashtra (Pune, Shegaon), Haryana (Faridabad), and Tamil Nadu (Chennai). Cabins are typically delivered as fully assembled or semi-knocked-down (SKD) units and can be relocated using wheels or lifting hooks. ISO 9001:2015 certification is cited by leading manufacturers; no specific BIS/IS standard exclusively governs portable security cabins (they fall under general prefabricated structure norms). The regional term 'kabbina' (Telugu) is observed in buyer search data, confirming South Indian demand concentration alongside North Indian manufacturing hubs.
